model.assessment: Credible conservative local 1612 four-terminal visual proxy. It is centered, fits within the land envelope, and KiCad mirrors it automatically for the B.Cu footprint. It is not exact Epson CAD: the STEP header identifies KiCad's WE IQXC-26 model and the envelope is 0.10 mm wider/longer and 0.15 mm taller overall than the nominal FA-118T body. This is safe for collision visualization but must not be cited as manufacturer mechanical authority.
